spans.s:
मम मम, gen. case of the first personal
pronoun [cf. 3. म, अस्मद्] used in certain com-
pounds and to form a few derivatives; [cf. अ-म्˚, निर्-
म्˚, मामक, मामकीन.]
—मम-कार, अस्, m.
or मम-कृत्य, अम्, n. interesting one's self
about anything.
—मन्म-ता, f. ‘mineness,’ the sense
of ‘meum,’ the considering anything as belonging
to one's self, sense of ownership or self-interest,
appropriation, selfishness; individuality; pride, arro-
gance, self-sufficiency, attachment to, interest in [cf.
मम-त्व below]; N. of the wife of Utathya and
mother of Dīrgha-tamas, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-
veda

, ममता नाम ब्रह्म-वादिनी
दीर्घ-तमसो माता.)
—ममता-युक्त, अस्, आ,
अम्, filled with selfishness, selfish, miserly; (अस्), m.
a selfish man, miser, egotist.
—मम-त्व, अम्, n.
‘mineness,’ regarding as one's own, sense of owner-
ship, attachment to, interest in (generally with loc.
c., e. g. ममत्वम् मे तस्मिन्, I take an interest
in that; धने ममत्वं न कर्तव्यम्, one
must not become attached to wealth); pride, arro-
gance; [cf. मम-ता above.]
—मम-सत्य, अम्,
n., Ved. contest or struggle for ownership, (the con-
tending parties are supposed to say मम सत्यं
जय इति.)

मम्म मम्म, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—मम्-
म-स्वामिन्, N. of a temple built by Mamma.

माम माम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मम, gen. sing.
of 3. म), mine, my; mother, uncle, (in this sense
like तात, q. v., and commonly in voc. sing.)
ममक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. my, mine (see Pāṇ.
; cf. मामक).
मम्मक मम्मक, अस्, m. a proper N.

ममाय, Nom. A. ममायते, -यितुम्, to envy
any one (acc. c.).

ममत् ममत्, ind., Ved. ममत् — ममत्,
at one time — at another time; (but according to
Sāy. = माद्यत्, प्र-माद्यत्, प्र-मत्त), exult-
ing, impassioned, intoxicated with joy.

ममाथ ममाथ, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman;
(also मथात.)

ममापताल ममापताल, अस्, m. (according
to Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt. मव्य्, to bind, with affix
आल, य् being rejected, म् substituted for व्, and the
augment आपत् added) = विषय, an object of sense.

मम्ब् मम्ब्, cl. 1. P. मम्बति, &c., to
go, move.

मम्मट मम्मट, अस्, m., N. of the author
of the Kāvya-prakāśa and the Saṅgīta-ratna-mālā,
(said to be a contraction for महिम-भट्ट, also
written मम्मट-भट्ट.)
मम्रि मम्रि, इस्, इस्, इ, mortal. See अ-म्˚.
मामकीन, अस्, आ, or ई (?), अम्, my, mine.

मामतेय, अस्, m. (fr. ममता), a metronymic
of Dīrgha-tamas; (also read सामन्तेय.)

मामनसायति मामनसायति, इस्, m. a patro-
nymic (?).

मामल्लदेवी मामल्ल-देवी, f., N. of the
mother of Śrī-harṣa (author of the Naiṣadhīya-
caritra).
मामिडि मामिडि, इस्, m. a proper N.

मामुखी मामुखी, f., N. of a Buddhist
goddess.

मामुदगजनवी मामुद-गजनवी, m. =
محمود غزنوي i. e. Mahmūd of Ghaznī.

माम्पश्य माम्-पश्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. माम्,
acc. of अहम् + पश्य), Ved. regarding or looking
at me.
